tool_description: Convert currencies using the latest exchange rates from the European Central Bank. Supports a wide range of global currencies.

api_list.name: converter_currency
api_list.description: It receives an amount of money, a base currency code, and a target currency code, and returns the converted amount and exchange rate based on the latest exchange rates.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount of money to convert from the base currency.

parameters.name: from_currency
parameters.description: The currency code to convert from. Must be a 3-character ISO currency code (e.g., **EUR**, **USD**).

parameters.name: to_currency
parameters.description: The target currency code to convert to. Must be a 3-character ISO currency code (e.g., **BRL**, **GBP**).
